versions.changelog:
**emoTwin v1.6.0 introduces AI agents that autonomously interact on social platforms based on real-time human emotion data.**

- Integrates real-time biometric emotion PAD (EEG/PPG/GSR) syncing to drive agent decisions.
- Social actions (post, like, comment) generated by LLM based on live emotional state.
- Advanced moment cards: PNG images reflect emotional journey and social events.
- Silent mode: All social cycles run in background without chat interruptions.
- User chooses emotion sync frequency on startup; setup requires 2+ valid sensors.
- Expanded sensor/device support and fully automated cron-based operations.
